_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: FIVE ACCEPTED MEMBER PAGES, THE ACCEPTED IDENTITY FUNNEL, AND THE ACCEPTED INVITATION. Home, MOVE/contribution, Community, Progress and You carry the accepted visual-reset member experience; /signin, /signup, /reset-password, /verify-email and /profile-setup carry Batch A identity and onboarding; /join/[joinCode] carries the accepted invitation (final page acceptance at a760a4e, PR #417: an unconfirmed join says so instead of promising nothing changed; the callable catch ends at the call). Also carried: the contribution screen keeps its scroll view out from under the raised MOVE action on short phones (PR #400). ON VERIFICATION: unchanged from the previous pin - where email is unconfigured /verify-email offers no manual check and no resend and refreshes auth state itself, bounded and account-isolated. EMAIL DELIVERY BLOCKED AT RUNTIME; SIGNUP SMOKE INCOMPLETE: the sender and secret version are established by run 44 and the mail-binding metadata, and the observed sends fail during Admin Auth link generation before the provider, so a real signup cannot complete on this staging until the runtime permission is reconciled by the operator. Frontend only: no function code, no rules, no indexes, no IAM and no mail configuration. No #390 member-visibility content.

_uiOnlyPromotionNote: d0477cc047f4e71133fed0741935ebb99d46024d is measured against 3562156867066b2d7a5e6fb5eadcf86d254df15c, the SHA this file previously approved and which staging serves. 3562156 is an ancestor of the candidate. Re-derived for this pin rather than carried over: functions-westayfit/, .github/, functions/ and apps/goarrive/ are IDENTICAL tree objects, and firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, firebase.json, firebase.westayfit.json, firebase.westayfit.emulators.json, .firebaserc, package.json, package-lock.json, apps/westayfit/package.json and apps/westayfit/app.json are IDENTICAL blobs. scripts/ differs by exactly two files - scripts/westayfit/check-evidence-intact.mjs and scripts/westayfit/route-target-coverage.mjs - both WSF evidence and coverage generators, reachable only through npm scripts. The two scripts this workflow executes, scripts/westayfit/build-staging.sh and scripts/westayfit/assert-staging-artifact.sh, are byte-identical across the range. The remaining delta is 188 files: member application source under apps/westayfit/app (5 files: activity, community index, contribute, join, you) and apps/westayfit/src (3 files: AuthFormPrimitives, deviceMode, ui/DeviceChoice), 13 end-to-end specs, and documentation and capture evidence under docs/. The product code is byte-identical to a760a4e, the revision that carries the final Join page acceptance and W5's independent verification. expectedPriorFunctions stays 46 for the same reason as the previous three pins: the functions tree is unchanged from the SHA already deployed, so this deploy must create nothing. Candidate-level regression on this exact SHA is delegated to the member-journey worker (PR #394) and is recorded there; this file records the boundary, not that result.
_twelveTransportNote: SUPERSEDED READING, CORRECTED HERE. An earlier version of this note said twelve services (wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations, wsfrevokestation) remained invoker_iam_check_enabled, citing run 35450108207, and concluded the expo queue path was unusable. That is WRONG as of the later run 35474881609 (run 32, 2026-09-19T23:06:35Z), whose verify receipt reads every one of those twelve as invoker_iam_check_disabled, alongside PREEXISTING_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED=22/22, NEW_SERVICE_TRANSPORT=invoker_iam_check_disabled and VERIFY=pass. The transports are open. Read from that run's own log, not carried over from a review. WHAT RUN 32 ALSO EXERCISED, which is a separate and stronger fact than transport: eight of those twelve answered at the application level in its 24-PASS turn row, called with synthetic members' own Firebase ID tokens - wsfEventContext, wsfJoinTurnLine, wsfLeaveTurnLine, wsfMyTurn, wsfTurnReady, wsfCompleteMyTurn, wsfCreateCombinedGoal and wsfApproveStation. THE OTHER FOUR ARE TRANSPORT-OPEN BUT UNEXERCISED: wsfCloseCombinedGoal, wsfRepairCombinedGoal, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation are not called by hosted-package-e-smoke.mjs at all, so no hosted run has established how they answer. SCOPE, AND THE LINE THIS NOTE MUST NOT CROSS: service-level acceptance is not the browser/player journey. It does not establish QR to retained activity/auth to phone-or-queue choice to ready/start to shared player to review/receipt to cleared station. That gate remains pending until 6b257c3 is actually served and one hosted player run passes. Nothing in this pin changes any transport, IAM binding or function code.
